candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because its downstream call to order:8000/v1/orders returns HTTP 500; the order service is the failing dependency producing the gateway 5xx.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side logs/traces and its dependency (inventory/payment/postgresql) telemetry are absent, so the internal cause of the order 500 is not established.

report.explanation: Traces and logs consistently show gateway POST /v1/checkout returning 502 immediately after its client call to order:8000/v1/orders returns 500, across multiple correlation IDs. Topology confirms gateway->order dependency. The bounded cause is an order-service HTTP 500 propagating as gateway 502; the internal order fault is not yet localized.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/traces for the failing /v1/orders requests to identify the internal 500 cause
Order dependency telemetry (inventory, payment, postgresql) to rule out db-pool-exhaustion or downstream-latency
Order service metrics for error rate and latency during the incident window
